messages:
maria: Quick check  we need a lean webinar for July: title options? 1) "Operationalizing Inference" 2) "Webinar: Predictable Latency & Cost" 3) "Making fallbacks simple". Pick one and confirm speaker availability.
alex: leaning "Operationalizing Inference"  that covers routing, caching, and rollout.
nina: I can speak to the customer adoption angle and provide a short case vignette.
sam: Creative can do a 20s hero animation summarizing the three levers (routing, cache, quantization) if we lock title by EOD.
maria: Format idea: 30m main + 30m workshop breakout (hands-on prompts + evals). That would be unique and drive signups. Thoughts?
lee: Ops supports recorded demo + live Q&A. Need at least two rehearsal slots and one recorded intro. I have studio availability 7/14 or 7/21. calendar-bot: Tentative 7/21 09:00 PT added -> https://cal.example.com/event/1740002222
alex: If we do a workshop, we need a simple reproducible repo for attendees. Jordan? (tag) can you prep a lightweight evaluator harness?
nina: I'll write a 75-word blurb and 3 bulleted takeaways by Tue. Also will get headshot to Sam.
sam: Slide/repo deadlines: rough deck + repo skeleton by 7/1, final assets by 7/12. Promo clip by 7/15.
maria: Run-of-show sketch: 
```
00:00-00:05 - Intro + goals (maria)
00:05-00:20 - Key patterns: routing + caching (alex)
00:20-00:30 - Customer vignette + lessons (nina)
00:30-00:50 - Workshop: mini-hands-on (all leads)
00:50-01:00 - Q&A + next steps (panel)
```
Keep main content tight; workshop should be prescriptive.
lee: Registration form question: include "interested in Dedicated or Private" checkbox so we can route high-intent leads.
alex: Agreed. Also propose a quick poll during the event: "Which is your biggest constraint: cost/latency/reliability".
sam: I'll design social frames. Need copy and CTA by 7/5.
maria: Final action items: Nina -> blurb + takeaways by Tue; Alex -> demo checklist & repo stub by Fri; Sam -> promo assets schedule; Lee -> lock studio and registration flow. We'll reconvene for rehearsal invites.
lee: Studio locked 7/21 09:00 PT. calendar-bot: Recording confirmed.
maria: Locking topic: "Operationalizing Inference: routing, caching, and rollouts" unless objections in 2h. Thanks team!
